correctness.rationale: Exact characteristic-two group-algebra reduction proves the shifted update squares to zero. For n even an explicitly invertible generator substitution yields rank 2^(n-1); for n odd the alternating coefficient matrix has radical dimension one and its normal-form tensor homology gives rank 2^(n-1)-2^((n-1)/2). Rank-nullity then yields all transient depths or period-one/two counts, with exact boundary n≥2. Finite direct GF(2) adjacency, rank and orbit verification passed 67861 assertions independently; finite checks support rather than replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: The theorem classifies the complete functional graph of a canonical distance-two parity automaton for every n≥2, distinguishing nilpotent extinction from involutory periodicity by n modulo four and giving all class counts. The odd-dimensional rank correction depends on a nontrivial alternating-form/tensor-homology computation. The invariant is directly motivated by the arbitrary-graph parity rule and finite Hamming-shell geometry and clarifies why real tangent growth and modular state dynamics differ; this is neither an arbitrary small case nor a textbook rephrasing.
